caption:
A private beta just dropped for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, and landscaping shops.

GoHighLevel, one of the largest CRM platforms in the industry, launched Field Services on November 3: one place for quotes, scheduling, dispatch, invoicing, and payment.

The average job already passes through four or five separate tools. Every handoff between them is a place a lead can go quiet.

Do this today: count the apps one job touches from first call to final payment. Quote tool, calendar, dispatch text, invoice software, payment link. Four or more means four places something can fall through.

Black Arrow's platform already keeps that path in one system: CRM, booking, two-way texting, and revenue reporting, no beta required. 14 days free, no card.

rationale: News reels win cold-audience reach, and GoHighLevel's Nov 3 Field Services beta is a fresh, verifiable industry signal that the all-in-one consolidation thesis Black Arrow already sells is now an industry-wide fix. Field Services is in private beta: one place for quotes, scheduling, dispatch, invoicing, and payment, built for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, and landscaping businesses.
